title: LATE NIGHT AUDIO: A SETTING FOR SOFTER PEAKS
why: His yes on pick 74, the party volume governor. A new row in AUDIO, off by default, for a living room TV at night: the world compressor squeezes harder, the limiters catch peaks about 6 dB lower and the world trim drops 2 dB. Off is exactly the old mix.
now: Settings, AUDIO now has LATE NIGHT AUDIO. On, blasts and heavy guns hit softer and footsteps stay clear. Off is the old sound.
